premise: Young Deer wishes he had antlers instead of spots, until his spots make him impossible to find in the dappled grass during hide-and-seek.
inspiration: Kipling's Just So stories (how the animal got its coat), told truly and turned toward contentment: the thing he wished away is exactly right for now.
lesson: What you have right now is just right for who you are right now.
learning: A young deer's white spots look like patches of sunlight and fade as it grows up

en-US.title: Deer and His White Spots
en-US.text: Deer {deer:pulse} was a young deer, with a coat covered in little white spots. {deer:face sad} [sad] I wish I had big antlers, he sighed, like the grown-up deer. I've just got spots. Rabbit {rabbit:hop x2} bounced up. {rabbit:face happy} {deer:face normal} [excited] Let's play hide-and-seek! You hide! {canvas:sunshine 0.7 22s} So Deer lay down in the long grass under the trees, {sfx:grass} where the sunlight came through the leaves in little round patches. Rabbit {rabbit:hop} looked, and looked. Bird {bird:float loop 0.3} looked too. [curious] Where is he? {rabbit:face surprised} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Then Deer stood up, right in front of them! Rabbit {rabbit:wobble} nearly fell over. {rabbit:face happy} [laughs] Your spots look just like the sunshine on the ground! Bird {bird:hop} sang. Those spots are just right for a young deer. They fade as you grow up, and then come the antlers. {deer:face happy} [happily] Deer {deer:sparkle} looked at his spots. I think I'll keep them a little while, he said. {deer:hearts}

es-ES.title: Ciervo y sus manchas blancas
es-ES.text: Ciervo {deer:pulse} era un ciervo pequeño, con el pelo lleno de manchitas blancas. {deer:face sad} [sad] Ojalá tuviera astas grandes, suspiró, como los ciervos mayores. Yo solo tengo manchas. Conejo {rabbit:hop x2} llegó dando botes. {rabbit:face happy} {deer:face normal} [excited] ¡Vamos a jugar al escondite! ¡Escóndete tú! {canvas:sunshine 0.7 22s} Así que Ciervo se tumbó en la hierba alta, bajo los árboles, {sfx:grass} donde el sol se colaba entre las hojas en manchitas redondas. Conejo {rabbit:hop} buscó, y buscó. Pájaro {bird:float loop 0.3} también buscó. [curious] ¿Dónde está? {rabbit:face surprised} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Entonces Ciervo se levantó, justo delante de ellos! Conejo {rabbit:wobble} casi se cae. {rabbit:face happy} [laughs] ¡Tus manchas parecen el sol en el suelo! Pájaro {bird:hop} cantó. Esas manchas son perfectas para un ciervo pequeño. Se borran cuando creces, y entonces llegan las astas. {deer:face happy} [happily] Ciervo {deer:sparkle} se miró las manchas. Creo que me las quedo un tiempo, dijo. {deer:hearts}
